children: Brian Kelly, CEO of The Points Guy, said consumers are using loyalty rewards for immediate savings as everyday costs rise, Bloomberg reported. Fuel and dining programs had 88% consumer satisfaction, which Kelly linked to stagnant wages and climbing expenses.

The Points Guy’s State of Loyalty report focuses on where consumer trust and loyalty are growing, rather than whether people are loyal overall. Kelly discussed the findings with Romaine Bostick on “The Close.”

title: The Points Guy CEO Brian Kelly Says Consumers Are Using Loyalty Rewards
